accumulates__lesch_nyhan.subject: lesch_nyhan
accumulates__lesch_nyhan.source: Pathogenic variants in HPRT1 are almost always associated with clinical evidence for overproduction of uric acid (hyperuricemia, nephrolithiasis, and/or gouty arthritis). ...
